what.en: Develops Cxbladder, a suite of non-invasive, urine-based genomic biomarker tests for ruling out and monitoring bladder cancer, run out of ISO15189 labs in New Zealand and CLIA/CAP/NYS-certified labs in the US.
what.zh: 開發 Cxbladder,一套非侵入式、以尿液為檢體的基因體生物標記檢驗,用於排除與追蹤膀胱癌,由紐西蘭的 ISO15189 實驗室與美國 CLIA/CAP/NYS 認證實驗室執行。

summary.en: Dunedin, New Zealand genomic-diagnostics company (dual-listed NZX/ASX:PEB since 2003) behind the Cxbladder suite of urine tests for bladder cancer detection and surveillance, led by CEO Peter Meintjes.
